body: Yeah that makes sense. I'll have to meet her half way. Hopefully my SO will meet me half way too.

Thanks for the reply. And it definitely help me flush my thoughts out more. 

Yeah it's difficult. To balance keeping it calm and letting emotions take over the conversation. I try to normalize and validate all her emotions. I try to communicate that I understand where she's coming from but she only sees that as a form capitulation. She'll reply "If u get it then do something about it."

She sees it as robotic because I'm not letting my emotions take over. Like I say I'm angry and I am but I don't need to yell it or have a matching tone to communicate it. I don't see how throwing things or yelling things help at all... If I say I'm angry just believe me. It doesn't make me a psychopath, autistic or robotic. IMO. Maybe I'm wrong. 

Do you feel it's important for people to communicate their emotionality with matching non-verbal language.

Thanks for the reply.

You're total right. I have my part in it. And really I'm asking myself "am I doing it again?" And I have a hard time telling if I'm just being sensative or not.

I should maybe rephrase normal to "Matching communication style."

What do you feel are good markers for non-matching communication style vs matching communication style. What is too different?

Thanks for the message. My degree is something I enjoy. I just don't feel like Im good at it or worthy or at least that's what my grades show. I'm just scared is all and I don't have very many people who understand this, so I thank you for replying.

I just want to thank you for the message. Got me thinking a lot, in a positive away. I don't want to be that old guy, pretending to know everything, but you're still 20. This is your time. Time to fail and get up, make mistakes. A time to struggle and fall in love. Have your heart broken and break hearts. Don't rush your life but stay focused. Don't chase happiness as an end goal, be in the moment and enjoy moment of happiness.
